facts.name: D. Melissa Distler
facts.assignment: Division60, misdemeanor criminal and juvenile delinquency at Kim C. Hammond Justice Center; basic noncivil operating review.

contact.contact_note: Shared judicial office/assistant telephone; no separate personal judicial email established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Email assistant after filing motion, copying all parties; include case number, motion and requested time. File and serve notice after reservation; notify assistant and file cancellation notice when cancelling.

proposed_orders.summary: Use proposed-order portion of Florida Courts E-Filing Portal; PDF or Word under practices document. Do not email orders unless requested by court.

remote_appearances.summary: Zoom available subject to court instructions. Practices document requests written permission outside arraignments/pretrials; general procedures additionally permit counsel at short non-evidentiary hearings. Confirm applicable authorization; see recorded discrepancy.

chambers_communications.summary: Email assistant with case number/name and subject, copying opposing counsel and self-represented parties; no ex parte communications.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email copies to assistant. General procedures state three business days for memoranda/authorities; practices document states two business days for evidentiary courtesy copies and hearing materials. Both retained.

conferral.summary: General procedures ask parties to try resolving motions and include opposing position. Specialized criminal motion rules were not reviewed.

facts.summary: Email-coordinated hearings, e-portal proposed orders and conditional Zoom appearances. Basic noncivil operating review.

review_scope.collected: Full profile HTML and two PDFs (four and seven pages), with extracted text and acquisition metadata.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Profile contacts/assignment; general document basic scheduling, submission, communication and appearance sections; practices pages1–5 corresponding office operations only.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Criminal litigation substance, plea forms, trial/exhibit requirements and specialized forms; practices pages6–7 collected without substantive review.

statements.statement: General procedures page3: memoranda and cited authorities at least three business days before hearing.
Practices pages3/5: hearing materials and evidentiary courtesy copies no later than two business days before hearing.

conflicts.resolution: Recorded only; no determination of control.

statements.statement: General page1 permits counsel Zoom at pretrials and non-evidentiary hearings under30minutes; arraignments Courtroom101 until October1 and all proceedings404 beginning November1, leaving October arraignment room unstated.
Practices page4 requires written requests outside arraignment/pretrial conferences.

conflicts.resolution: Recorded only; do not infer blanket permission or October arraignment location.

gaps: Personal judicial email and distinct assistant-only telephone not established.

facts.name: Christopher A. France
facts.assignment: Flagler Division47 Unified Family; profile also lists Division51 probate at Putnam County. Putnam procedure link is retained with its county limitation, not applied to Flagler.

contact.contact_note: Division47 mailbox for court-requested Word orders and filed emergency motions; shared office/assistant phone. Fax identified by official HTML fax icon.

hearing_scheduling.summary: Coordinate available times through Flagler Benchmark, then reserve blocks and file notice with motion docket number and reserved time. Email assistant for short expedited slots; cancellations require assistant contact and filed notice.

proposed_orders.summary: Division47 procedures direct filing through e-portal as an ordinary pleading, expressly not its proposed-order option. Email Word orders to division47 only when directed or for competing post-hearing orders as specified.

remote_appearances.summary: In person except case-management conferences and docket sounding; other remote requests require motion with cause/opposition position and proposed order. Court reporters in person.

chambers_communications.summary: Email preferred; copy opposing parties but omit assistant from parties’ scheduling-coordination conversations. Use assistant for office requests.

conferral.summary: Represented motions include opposing position; agreed motions ordinarily need no hearing.

courtesy_copies.summary: Separate general courtesy-copy policy not established in bounded basic operations review; specialized family exhibit instructions retained but not substantively reviewed.

facts.summary: Flagler family division uses Benchmark scheduling, email office communications, e-portal submissions and in-person default. Basic noncivil review; Putnam probate instructions are separately labeled.

review_scope.collected: Official profile HTML and full five-page2026 family procedures PDF.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Profile contacts/assignments/links; PDF pages1–3 basic communications, scheduling, order submissions and appearance directions.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Family merits, settlement standards, trial dates and exhibit litigation instructions; Putnam probate document linked but not collected in this Flagler review.

conflicts.topic: Portal submission routes differ by division
conflicts.statement: France family page1 says not to use proposed-order option; Distler practices page5 expressly requires that option. Preserve division-specific instructions; neither is asserted as a countywide rule.

gaps: No personal judicial email, distinct assistant-only phone or separate general courtesy-copy rule established.

citations.locator: Profile contacts, HTML fax icon and assignment county distinctions

citations.locator: Pages1–3 basic operations; remaining family trial/exhibit material collected only

facts.name: Linda L. Gaustad
facts.assignment: Division48 Flagler probate/guardianship; also Division10 Volusia. Listed judicial office is in DeLand, while Flagler hearings are at Kim C. Hammond Justice Center or authorized remotely.

contact.contact_note: Flagler orders use Division48 mailbox; Division10 mailbox is Volusia only. Shared office/assistant telephone; no personal judicial email established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion first, then coordinate with counsel and email assistant identifying Flagler/Division48, case number, motion docket number and time. File notice immediately; notify assistant immediately and file notice when cancelling.

proposed_orders.summary: Email Word attachment to division48@circuit7.org, subject Proposed Order with case style/number; do not file Division48 proposed orders through e-portal. Post-hearing orders identify opposing counsel review and agreement.

remote_appearances.summary: One hour or longer, or evidentiary, in person unless otherwise ordered; shorter non-evidentiary hearings by Zoom. Notice identifies platform and location; official order supplies credentials.

chambers_communications.summary: Contact assistant, not judge, about office operations. Use correct county/division in subject; profile prohibits direct case discussion with judge.

courtesy_copies.summary: Email hearing notice to assistant. Filed memoranda/authorities and any chambers copy must reach court at least three business days before hearing.

conferral.summary: Coordinate hearing with all counsel and present post-hearing proposed order to opposing counsel before submission.

facts.summary: Flagler probate Division48 uses email scheduling and Word orders through its dedicated mailbox; listed office is DeLand. Review limited to recurring office operations.

review_scope.collected: Full official profile HTML and three-page Division48 standing order with text and page renders.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Profile contacts/assignment and Division48 operations; standing-order hearing scheduling, submissions, communication and appearance sections, visually checked on all three pages. Signature date visually verified November15,2024.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Probate merits/checklists, individual motion litigation standards, Volusia standing order and linked rule compilations; links retained as applicable.

gaps: Personal judicial email, separate assistant telephone and separate Flagler chambers mailing address not established.
